propositions: Jira Data Center and Cloud diverge on REST protocol (v2 vs v3), authentication (PAT bearer vs ACLI), user identity (name vs accountId), and rich-text format (wiki-markup vs ADF), requiring a shared abstraction layer rather than fork-and-duplicate adapters

Current state has two independent copies of field/status/priority maps across adapters/jira/ and adapters/outbound_fields.py which have drifted (deleted key disagreement) and a third in config.py, creating a single source of truth problem

The Jira family seam must be an explicit sub-seam with contracts for RichTextCodec and UserIdentityModel parameterizing vendor-specific behavior, while location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) stay in place and import from jira_family to invert the dependency

DC transport requires https:// with certificate verification never disabled, PAT from env-only not config, and operator-configured resolved_statuses to correctly classify workflow states that may differ from Cloud's defaults

Acceptance requires zero cross-imports between adapters/jira/ and adapters/jira_datacenter/, one dict literal per shared value map within adapters/, and a bidirectional reconcile pass demonstrated live against real Jira DC 8.17.1
